---
title: Configuration Guide
---

A key that isn't a breakpoint name is ignored, and the render reports a
`Q-13-18` warning that points at it. For example, this item's `md2` text
is never shown:

```yaml
- href: guide/configuration.qmd
  text:
    md2: Config        # Q-13-18: not a breakpoint name
    xl: Configuration Guide
```

Responsive text is a navbar feature. Sidebar and page-footer items that
use a map-valued `text:` show only the widest variant.
